correctness.rationale: For q≥3 uniform proper colourings, the conditional expectation of a leaf character given its parent equals -r times the parent character, with r=(q-1)^-1; residual variance δ=1-r² and distinct leaves have conditionally orthogonal residuals. This yields G_s=[[C,-r C R],[-rR^T C,δI+r²R^TC R]]. Leaf contrasts give δ multiplicity n(s-1) and core+leaf averages yield B_s(c) 2x2 blocks with trace δ+(1+s r²)c and determinant δc, giving exact eigenvalues and nullity. Both λ± increase strictly in c>0; as s grows trace increases while product fixed, so condition worsens; λ+=sr²c+O(1), λ-=δ/(sr²)+O(s^-2), squared condition grows b r⁴/δ*s². Independent direct colouring enumeration and Gram spectral calculations agree for four examples.
residual_risks: Equal independent pendants at every core vertex, uniform proper q≥3 colours, Fourier degree one, positive C for conditioning; no q=2, interactions between leaves or joint growth uniformity.
